name: SVG Converter
description: Batch-convert SVG vector graphics to PNG, JPEG or WebP bitmaps at any size without quality loss
help: Rasterizes SVG files in Rust and writes PNG (transparency preserved), JPEG or WebP; files never leave your computer.
Vector graphics stay sharp when scaled: resize by percentage (up to 1000%) or fit within width/height, larger than the original is fine.
Open or drop one or more SVG files; conversions run one by one with real-time logs.
JPEG has no transparency, so transparent areas are flattened onto white.
